user.title: BMW CarData – Enter Client ID
user.description:
Enter your BMW CarData Client ID from the portal.

To get one: visit {portal_url}, select your vehicle, then generate a Client ID under the 'CarData API' section.

authorize.title: BMW CarData – Authorise Device
authorize.description:
**Open this link in your browser and enter the code below:**

🔗 [{verification_url}]({verification_url})

**Code:** `{user_code}`

Once you have approved the device on the BMW page, click **Submit**.

error.invalid_client_id: Client ID looks invalid – it should be a UUID from the BMW portal.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to BMW. Check your Client ID and internet connection.
error.authorization_pending: You haven't approved the device yet. Visit the URL, enter the code, and click Submit again.
error.auth_failed: Authorisation failed or expired. Please start again.

abort.already_configured: BMW CarData is already configured for this vehicle.
abort.no_vehicles: No vehicles found on this BMW account.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect to BMW CarData API.
abort.api_not_enabled: BMW CarData API access is not activated. In the BMW portal, click 'Request access to CarData API', wait 60 seconds, then try again.

auth_failed.title: BMW CarData authentication failed
auth_failed.description:
The BMW CarData integration could not authenticate. Your access token may have expired.

Please remove and re-add the integration from Settings → Devices & Services → BMW CarData.
